objective: Preregister 24 candidates -- the exact rotation_cell cross-sectional momentum rotation mechanism already live on S1-S3, unedited, applied to a FACTOR-style ETF menu (MTUM/QUAL/USMV/VLUE/SIZE) and a narrow INDUSTRY ETF menu (SMH/XBI/KRE/ITB/IGV/XOP/XRT/IHI), grid = lookback {63,126,252} x top_n {1,2} x rebalance {monthly,weekly} -- for a batch screening lane to test against K1 (own date-neutral Sharpe >= 80% of S3's in both the anchor and stress windows, with positive CAGR at 20bp) or K2 (a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in both windows). No backtest is run in this round; this manifest is the preregistration handed to the screening lane.

data_v1_sip_daily_equity_etf_menus_panel.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count
data_v1_sip_daily_equity_etf_menus_panel.source: alpaca SIP daily archive, fully adjusted closes
data_v1_sip_daily_equity_etf_menus_panel.confirmed_coverage: All 13 new tickers (5 FACTOR + 8 INDUSTRY) plus SHY are present in data/sip/daily/*/*.parquet from 2016-01-04 through 2026-09-28 per the queue task's own precheck; no new data fetch is needed for this round.

feature_v1_rotation_cell_reuse.definition: Each candidate's weight vector is produced by scripts/screen_batches/h20260928_40_equity_etf_menus.py's make_rotation_fn(menu, lookback, top_n) closure, which imports run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.momentum_score unedited (close.pct_change(lookback, fill_method=None)) and reproduces rotation_cell's top-N rank plus absolute-momentum-vs-SHY filter, using only rows with index <= asof.

label_v1_close_signal_next_open_fill.definition: signal computed at session close; weights effective at the next session open (next_bar_open fill), matching the frozen S1/S2/S3 convention.

holdout_2026_contaminated: S3's own anchor window already covers part of this range; reported for reference only.
validation_v1_s3_stress_anchor_holdout20.rebalance_offset_robustness: Metrics are the median over rebalance-day offsets: monthly candidates use offsets 0-20 trading days, weekly candidates use offsets 0-4 trading days.
validation_v1_s3_stress_anchor_holdout20.s3_reference_numbers: S3's own date-neutral Sharpe (median over 21 monthly offsets) is 1.49 in the anchor window and 0.81 in the stress window (owner-cited 2026-09-28); K1's bars are 1.19 and 0.65 respectively.

trial_count_and_dsr_note: This batch has 24 preregistered candidates. Whichever candidates pass K1 or K2 must report deflated Sharpe (DSR) with n_trials=24, the size of this batch.

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (median over rebalance offsets) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH the anchor window (>=1.19) and the stress window (>=0.65), at 10bp per side, with positive CAGR at 20bp per side.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control (k solved so realized volatility matches) by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH the anchor and stress windows.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= 1.19 (K1's anchor bar) but stress window does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only, not a keep.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.49 anchor / 0.81 stress).
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: 24 candidates; report all regardless of outcome; DSR with n_trials=24 for any that pass.
